name: TC-DASH-E2E: Complete Dashboard Load State, KPI Metrics Table & Count Synchronization Flow
description:
Single-session verification of Dashboard KPI count synchronization:
1. Authenticate and navigate to Busy Pvt. Ltd. Dashboard
2. Verify 'Tasks for Today' section visibility
3. Locate and extract Dashboard KPI metrics table structure
4. Extract Total Lead count from KPI table
5. Click Lead count to navigate to Lead listing and verify count match
